name: EOD: answers onto the Sales Call
description: D356 (Tyler, 2026-11-20: the closer's end of day is where a call's answers come from, and GHL keeps them). Each closing call the closer files on the end of day writes what they answered onto that call's Sales Call: next steps, next follow-up date, cash collected, contract value and package. Only answers given are written; a blank answer leaves the field as it is. Runs on every filing, including a call carried from an earlier day, so a field filled later reaches GHL too.

nodes.title: The call's Sales Call: what the closer answered
